# Payhip

> Payhip is a free all-in-one platform for creators to sell digital downloads, online courses, coaching services, memberships, and physical products with integrated payment processing and marketing tools.

Payhip provides a no-code solution for entrepreneurs and creators to build online stores and monetize their products without technical expertise. The platform supports multiple payment gateways including Stripe, PayPal, and Square, with built-in features for VAT/tax compliance, email marketing integrations, and comprehensive marketing tools.

## Key Topics

- Digital downloads
- Online courses
- Memberships
- Payment gateways
- Stripe integration
- PayPal integration
- Online store builder

## Core Features & Products

- [Sell Online For Free - Payhip Features](https://payhip.com/features/sell-online): Overview of Payhip's core selling features for digital products, courses, coaching, and memberships
- [Sell Digital Products & Downloads For Free - Payhip](https://payhip.com/features/sell-digital-downloads): Digital downloads feature with secure instant delivery and checkout optimization
- [Sell Courses Online For Free - Payhip](https://payhip.com/features/sell-courses): Course selling platform with lesson types, drip content, and student certificates
- [Sell Memberships Online For Free - Payhip](https://payhip.com/features/sell-memberships): Membership platform with recurring payments, tiered plans, and exclusive content
- [Sell Online Coaching For Free - Payhip](https://payhip.com/features/sell-coaching): Online coaching platform with scheduling, video calls, and client management
- [Sell Physical Products Online For Free - Payhip](https://payhip.com/features/sell-physical-products): Physical product sales with payment gateways, VAT/tax handling, and order management

## Store Building & Customization

- [Free Online Store Builder - Ecommerce with Payhip](https://payhip.com/features/online-store-builder): No-code store builder with custom domains, multi-language support, and mobile responsiveness
- [Free Themes For Your Online Store - Payhip](https://payhip.com/themes): Free customizable store themes: Echoes, Harvest, Enigma, Oasis with no coding required

## Payments & Compliance

- [Ecommerce Payment Gateways | Accept Payments with Payhip](https://payhip.com/payment-gateways): Payment gateway integrations: Stripe, PayPal, Square, Mollie, Paystack, Mercado Pago
- [Sales Tax & VAT - Payhip Features](https://payhip.com/features/vat-taxes): EU/UK VAT compliance and sales tax management for digital products

## Marketing & Growth Tools

- [Top Marketing Tools - Payhip Features](https://payhip.com/features/marketing-tools): Built-in marketing tools: coupons, affiliate programs, referrals, reviews, upsells
- [What is Email Marketing? - Payhip Features](https://payhip.com/features/email-marketing): Email marketing with integrations to AWeber, ConvertKit, Campaign Monitor, and Drip
